newsitem.title: UK: MTV Europe to launch new UK service on July 1.
newsitem.headline: MTV Europe to launch new UK service on July 1.

text.p: MTV Networks Europe on Wednesday said it will begin broadcasting the new UK version of its MTV music service in the UK and Ireland on July 1.
The channel will feature new British presenters, new shows, new short-segment material and the first phase of a redeveloped on-air identity.

MTV, part of Viacom Inc, said its new UK service will feature a higher rotation of music videos and an increase in the total hours of music played. The service is available in six million cable and satellite homes in the UK and Ireland.
